clue.text: So against making a single revision to parts of Bible

indicators.note: a single revision means just one letter of the word for Bible parts is altered

parts.note: the Bible is divided into chapters and verses

explanation.surface: Someone opposes the idea of tinkering even slightly with passages of scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making a single revision to' changes one letter of VERSES: its second E becomes U. 'So' is a link meaning 'thus'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin preposition used in legal case names and sports fixtures means opposed to or pitted against.

clue.text: Without books one discovered about strange things

parts.note: ex means without, as in ex dividend
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books
I is the Roman numeral for one
ca, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Someone with no reading matter finds a story about something odd.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural word means curious, foreign or unusual objects collected for their strangeness.

clue.text: Weapon for which commander out East has little time

indicators.note: the commander has, that is holds within him, the abbreviation for time

parts.note: a shogun was a military commander in feudal Japan
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A general in the Orient is too busy to bother with a particular firearm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for which' is only a link; T sits inside SHOGUN between O and G.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoothbore gun firing pellets, used for hunting, is a firearm.

clue.text: An instrument of the devil

definitions.meaning: an old bass wind instrument in the shape of a snake, used in church bands
Satan, who tempted Eve in Eden in the form of a snake

explanation.surface: Some tool or agent serves the purposes of Satan.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the snake: a curling bass wind horn, and the tempter of Genesis.

clue.text: Comedian putting question to priest in funny way

indicators.note: rearranged in a comic way, the letters of the clergyman word are shuffled

explanation.surface: A stand-up comic puts an amusing query to a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting ... to' reads as asking a question of someone; here it just joins the pieces. 'in funny way' gives IPSTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who makes witty remarks or jokes is a kind of comic.

clue.text: Provincial type must learn to change

indicators.note: the letters of the two words must change their order

explanation.surface: A country bumpkin is told he has to adapt his ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' rearranges MUST LEARN. The province is Ulster, the northern Irish province.
explanation.definitionFit: A man from Ulster, one of the four historic provinces of Ireland, is a provincial native.

clue.text: Common ways to present bill — in figures

indicators.note: the bill is placed in the middle of the figures

parts.note: prices are figures quoted for goods
an Act begins as a bill in Parliament

explanation.surface: Advice on the usual methods of setting out an invoice with numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to present' is only a link. 'bill' tempts as an invoice, but here it is a draft law, an Act.
explanation.definitionFit: Customs or habitual procedures are usual ways of doing things.

clue.text: Pick from hand the best card?

definitions.meaning: the choicest fruit taken from a bunch, which is called a hand of bananas
the leading comedian on a bill, a card being a joker or comic

explanation.surface: A card player wonders which of his cards is the strongest to lead.
explanation.walkthrough: A bunch of bananas is a 'hand'; 'card' means an amusing person, and the phrase was vaudeville slang for the star comic.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means the boss or chief person, here also the choicest fruit of a bunch.

clue.text: Ruler said, perhaps, to have returned to country

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the two words might be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A monarch is reported to have gone home to his own land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges RULER SAID. 'to have' is a link; 'country' means countryside, not nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Made rural again: given back to the countryside after urban use.

clue.text: A train off the rails

definitions.meaning: short for locomotive, the engine pulling a train
slang for crazy, from Spanish for mad

explanation.surface: A railway service has been derailed.
explanation.definitionFit: The short word is both an engine on a railway and informal for mad.

clue.text: Swimmer embarrassed by paparazzo

parts.note: red, as in red-faced
a snapper is a press photographer

explanation.surface: A bather is mortified at being photographed by intrusive press.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish food fish of warm seas is a creature that swims.

clue.text: Stocking river repeatedly with good carp

indicators.note: the river is stocked with, so holds inside it, the letters for good

parts.note: the Nile, the great African river

indicators.note: repeatedly means the abbreviation for good appears twice

explanation.surface: An angler fills a river again and again with fine carp fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carp' looks like the fish to be stocked but is the verb: to grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to find petty fault, to complain about trifles.

clue.text: Round fare for a stupid American

definitions.meaning: a ball of minced beef, food that is round
US slang for a dull-witted person

explanation.surface: A ticket for a circular journey bought for an American fool.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a ball of minced meat and American slang for an idiot.

clue.text: Campaign to get sailors in boats at sea with marines

indicators.note: the sailors are placed inside the shuffled boats
at sea means confused, so the letters of the vessels word are muddled

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
RM is the Royal Marines

explanation.surface: A recruiting drive for navy men to serve aboard ships with the marines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' gives BASTO, which 'in' opens to hold the Royal Navy. 'Campaign' is a verb: to tour making speeches.
explanation.definitionFit: To barnstorm is to tour rural areas making political speeches, a lively campaign.

clue.text: Fare for those taking flight from here

definitions.text: Fare for those taking flight from here

parts.words: Fare for those taking flight from here
parts.note: reads like an airport ticket desk, but the fare is food and those who fly off are garden birds

explanation.surface: Ticket prices for passengers departing from this airport.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised platform in a garden where food is put out for wild birds, who fly from it.

clue.text: Singer having sort of wine and port, say

parts.note: red is a kind of wine

indicators.note: say means the port's name is spoken and heard as a body word

parts.note: Brest is a port in Brittany, France

explanation.surface: A vocalist drinks red wine and port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' asks for a word that sounds like BREST, the French port.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin, a songbird, is known for its red chest; any songbird is a singer in crosswords.

clue.text: Winning team possibly getting chocolate, say

parts.note: winning means charming or engaging, so sweet

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters of the side's word may be set out differently

explanation.surface: The victorious side may be handed chocolates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winning' suggests victory but means charming; 'possibly' rearranges TEAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Chocolate is one example of a confection or sugary delicacy.

clue.text: Rest after working, more often than not

indicators.note: the remainder word follows the word for working

parts.note: on means functioning, switched on
the balance is the rest or remainder

explanation.surface: A worker usually takes a break after the job is done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rest' tempts as a break from work, but here it is the remainder of an account.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means taking everything into account, broadly or usually.

clue.text: Anarchy as men find nothing in place of power

indicators.note: the men find a zero, the round letter, standing where the power letter had been

parts.note: chaps are men

explanation.surface: Disorder breaks out as men find they have no power left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is a link; the P of CHAPS is replaced by O.
explanation.definitionFit: Total disorder or confusion is lawless lack of government.

clue.text: Heading off to cross highland region

indicators.note: the heading, or first letter, of the word is taken off

parts.note: to bridge a gap is to cross it

explanation.surface: Setting out to traverse an area of the Scottish Highlands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heading off' reads as setting out but removes the first letter of BRIDGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A long raised stretch of land, an elevated crest, is upland country.

clue.text: Area the players on the field have covered

definitions.text: Area the players on the field have covered

parts.words: Area the players on the field have covered
parts.note: sounds like ground a sports team covers in a match, but means a roofed platform in a park where musicians play

explanation.surface: Commentary on the ground a team has run during a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofed outdoor platform where a band of musicians performs, often in a park.

clue.text: Tides swirling round river bank

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go round the river
swirling waters stir the letters of the sea word into a new order

parts.note: the Po is the river of northern Italy

explanation.surface: Tidal currents eddy round a river's banks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swirling' gives DESIT, wrapped 'round' the Italian river. 'bank' is a verb: to pay money in.
explanation.definitionFit: To bank money is to place it in an account for safekeeping.

clue.text: Impressive recital

definitions.meaning: striking or effective, as a forceful argument
the act of narrating, as in the recounting of a story

explanation.surface: A concert that made a deep impression.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both effective and striking, and the act of narrating a tale.

clue.text: Work with dough, say, mainly occupied making money

indicators.note: say tells us the baker's verb is heard, not seen

parts.note: to knead is to work dough

indicators.note: mainly means most of the word, its final letter dropped

parts.note: full means occupied, as a full seat

explanation.surface: A baker mostly busy kneading turns a profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' is a link. 'the needful' is informal for the cash required.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase 'the needful' is slang for ready cash, what is required.

clue.text: Accelerator in car or choke

definitions.meaning: the pedal or valve controlling fuel to the engine

explanation.surface: Advice on a car's pedals: use the gas or the cold-start control.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names the engine's fuel valve and also means to strangle.

clue.text: Haggle to get a penny change

parts.note: to alter is to change

explanation.surface: Bargaining hard to win a single penny in change.
explanation.definitionFit: To palter is an old verb meaning to bargain or quibble over terms.

clue.text: Bowler's first to get level, then five points in front

indicators.note: first means just the opening letter of the bowler

parts.note: to raze a building is to level it
N, N, E, S, S are compass points

explanation.surface: A cricket bowler's first ball levels the scores before he moves five points ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'front' is the definition, meaning effrontery; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Front here is impudence or effrontery, shameless boldness.

clue.text: Data held by government department

parts.note: in means held by, contained
FO is the Foreign Office

explanation.surface: Records kept by a ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for information, it means facts or particulars.

clue.text: Championship secured in final with style?

indicators.note: the title is secured within the word for final

parts.note: the end is the final part
a title is a championship

explanation.surface: A sports star clinches a championship in a stylish final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with style?' plays on 'style' meaning a formal title, as in a noble's form of address.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a right to a title or style of address, as a titled person does.

clue.text: Switch on computer and get log modified

indicators.note: modified tells us the two short words are altered in order

explanation.surface: Advice to turn the computer on and adjust the log file.
explanation.definitionFit: A key or control that alternates between two states is a computing switch.
